highlights.title: OpenAI’s Sam Altman to Promote AI Standards During UN Speech
highlights.description: OpenAI’s Sam Altman will pitch the idea of creating global AI standards when he speaks at the United Nations on Wednesday, positioning himself as a centrist on the question of whether to slow down the technology’s progress.

highlights.title: Nvidia-Backed AI Startup Seeks $10 Billion Before Australian IPO
highlights.description: Australian AI startup Firmus Technologies Pty is in talks with lenders for a roughly $10 billion financing deal to buy Nvidia Corp. chips for its Indonesian data center, potentially making it one of Asia’s largest AI infrastructure deals.

highlights.title: SoftBank Offers Record Yields on Jumbo Junk Bonds in AI Push
highlights.description: Billionaire Masayoshi Son’s SoftBank Group Corp. kicked off what’s set to be one of the largest corporate junk bond sales ever as the Japanese conglomerate offers record yields to entice investors into helping fund its unprecedented investments in artificial intelligence.

ai.title: OECD Says Central Banks Must Be Vigilant to Inflation Risks
ai.description: OECD Chief Economist Stefano Scarpetta discusses the outlook for inflation, the impact of artificial intelligence on the global economy and debt markets, and rising bond yields. Speaking on Bloomberg Television, Scarpetta says "central banks have to remain very vigilant” about the risk of higher prices. “They need to intervene like they have done so far, perhaps more than what they did in 2022,” he adds. (Source: Bloomberg)

devices.description: As confirmed by the website "Expand Mac mini," NAND storage in the new Mac mini models with the M6 and M5 Pro chips is soldered to the logic board, whereas the previous models with the M4 and M4 Pro chips have removable storage that can be upgraded. In other words, the new Mac mini does not support aftermarket storage upgrades.
